name: Rhythm — Skipping on the Glans
summary: Male variant of Rhythm (Skipping). Tap the glans in a steady beat, then occasionally skip a beat so the pattern stays repeatable but pleasantly unpredictable.
detailed_description: Skipping keeps a recognizable underlying rhythm while dropping the occasional beat, so the receiver can't fully predict every tap—a tease layered onto repetition. On the glans, light taps land in a steady tempo and every few beats one is held back, then the pattern resumes. The familiar pulse keeps building while the skipped beats add anticipation.
stepwise_structure: 1. Tap the glans lightly in a steady, even beat.
3. Every few beats, skip one—pause, then resume the same beat.
4. Vary which beat you drop so it stays unpredictable.
5. Keep the underlying rhythm steady enough to still build.
safety_notes: Keep taps light on the sensitive head.
Don't break rhythm so often that the buildup is lost.

references.title: OMGYES — Rhythm (Season One)
references.note: Male variant adapted from Rhythm / Skipping.

meta.best_for: Repeatable beat with teasing dropped beats.
